# WebGPU CTS (webgpu:shader) WGSL round-trip sweep baseline.
# Generated by: PER_CASE=tests/webgpu_cts/per_case.tsv tools/webgpu_cts_sweep.sh
# See tests/webgpu_cts/README.md (what these numbers mean and do NOT mean) and
# tools/webgpu_cts_sweep.sh (classification + direction rationale).
#
# Corpus slice: 1613 unique CTS-authored WGSL shaders (cases/ + manifest.tsv),
# extracted from the webgpu:shader,validation suite of gpuweb/cts @ 2959e1c
# (BSD-3-Clause) by the headless framework driver (tools/webgpu_cts_dump.mjs):
# 47,515 enumerated cases -> 22,293 expectCompile{Result,Warning} captures ->
# unique expected=true entry-point shaders: 2,047 bucketed per spec file (2,046
# distinct texts; one shader is witnessed by two spec files and deduped at
# emission, duplicate_id_skipped=1) -> bounded slice (sha1 order, 100 per spec
# file, 91 spec files, ~320 KB of WGSL). From the full dump: 17,317
# expected=false (invalid-by-design WGSL; can never enter the round trip) and
# 2,862 no-entry-point module-scope cases are excluded and counted here, not
# silently dropped. 24,318 subcase-iterating cases were skipped by the dumper
# and 1,163 cases errored against the fake device (dump stats land next to the
# dump when regenerating); both are dumper scope, not corpus curation.
#
# Environment of this measurement: zioshade 0.6.0 (expand/webgpu-cts-slice, on
# top of e33cc373), naga 30.0.0, macOS. naga is the WGSL -> SPIR-V upstream
# converter and the output validator; tint (dawn 5e9e5136956e, built with
# TINT_BUILD_WGSL_READER+SPV_WRITER, at ~/.local/bin/tint) is the SECOND
# upstream converter for cases naga refuses. Without a tint binary on PATH the
# sweep degrades to naga-only and the upstream/refused split changes (see the
# 2026-08-17 naga-only row below); roundtrip-valid and zioshade-invalid are
# unaffected by tint's presence.
#
# 2026-08-16 first measurement (382-case slice):
#   roundtrip-valid          259  (67.8% of 382; 83.8% of the 309 cases that
#                                  survived the upstream naga leg)
#   upstream-convert-failed   67  (naga front end refuses: 50x subgroups
#                                  enable, 5x @diagnostic, 5x const-expr
#                                  determinant, 4x atomic_vec2u_min_max, ...;
#                                  not zioshade's)
#   zioshade-refused          17  (honest errors incl. UnsupportedOp opcode
#                                  228 atomics, texture type variants)
#   zioshade-invalid          39  (exit 0, naga rejects the output)
#   CRASH                      0
#
# 2026-08-16 after fix/wgsl-cts-undeclared-ids (#637, 382-case slice):
#   roundtrip-valid          302 / upstream-convert-failed 67 (unchanged) /
#   zioshade-refused 13 / zioshade-invalid 0 (all 39 fixed) / CRASH 0.
#   Fixed classes: OpConstantNull use-site folding, depth-texture scalar
#   forms, image-query signedness, depth-only fragments, MRT field types,
#   unreachable-function pruning.
#
# 2026-08-17 slice expanded 382 -> 1613 cases (per-spec-file cap 5 -> 100, same
# pin 2959e1c; fetch verified byte-reproducible end to end). First measurement
# on the expanded slice at e33cc373 (naga-only upstream):
#   roundtrip-valid          981
#   upstream-convert-failed  582   (subgroups specs dominate: ~460 cases)
#   zioshade-refused          33
#   zioshade-invalid          17  (exit 0, naga rejects the output)
#   CRASH                      0
# All 17 fixed the same day (src/spirv_to_wgsl.zig), none needed a refusal:
#   1. 16 cases: a module-scope var<private> whose OpVariable initializer is
#      OpConstantNull (4) or OpConstantTrue/False (12) had no
#      resolveConstantExpr fold, so the Private emitter skipped the
#      declaration while use sites still referenced the name. Null now folds
#      to the zero literal of its own type, true/false to bool literals.
#   2. 3 of those (write-only privates: OpStore, never OpLoad/AccessChain)
#      ALSO failed the has_load usage gate; stores now count as usage.
#   3. 1 case: a fragment with @location outputs AND @builtin(frag_depth)
#      fabricated `@location(0) color: vec4f`, dropping the real (scalar,
#      non-zero-location) outputs while their OpStores still emitted. The
#      frag_depth var no longer enters the location list; the struct carries
#      the real fields + depth; the return takes one argument per field.
# After the fixes (naga-only): 998 / 582 / 33 / 0 / 0.
#
# 2026-08-17 tint added as the second upstream converter (naga first, tint
# second; upstream-convert-failed now means BOTH refused). First tint run
# found 2 MORE zioshade-invalids (tint SPIR-V shapes naga never emits):
#   4. 2 cases: the selection-phi prologue's "initializer defined before the
#      if" check compared words[2] against the value id for EVERY instruction,
#      but words[2] is a result id only for value-producing ops; an OpName
#      string word that numerically equals an arm-local value id (tint names a
#      transfer-function constant "B", string word 66) let the then-arm value
#      pass as an in-scope var initializer. The check is now index-backed
#      (id_defs).
#
# 2026-08-17 final (with tint):
#   roundtrip-valid          1024
#   upstream-convert-failed    2  (both converters refuse: pipeline-
#                                  overridable constants without values,
#                                  `override block_width: i32;` and
#                                  `override o: u32;`; the CTS binds them at
#                                  pipeline creation, which no WGSL -> SPIR-V
#                                  converter can materialize headlessly)
#   zioshade-refused         587  (honest errors, measured: 546 subgroup-op
#                                  UnsupportedOp on tint-converted SPIR-V
#                                  [399 generic + 100 QuadSwap + 47
#                                  QuadBroadcast], 25 separate comparison
#                                  sampler, 4 SampledImage in switch/loop
#                                  replay, 4 @group/@binding collisions, 4
#                                  int64, 2 opcode-228 atomics, 2 gl_PointSize)
#   zioshade-invalid           0
#   CRASH                      0
#
# The zioshade-invalid class is the silent-wrong signal; it is 0 at this
# measurement. These are report-only findings (breadth on an unfamiliar
# corpus), follow-up beads, NOT gate failures.
#
#
# 2026-08-17 after fix/wgsl-cts-refusals (on top of #640):
#   roundtrip-valid         1055  (65.3% of 1613; 65.5% of the 1611 cases
#                                  that survived the upstream naga+tint leg)
#   upstream-convert-failed    2  (unchanged)
#   zioshade-refused         556  (31 lowered: 25 separate comparison samplers
#                                  via sampler_comparison typing + arrayed/
#                                  offset compare forms, 2 OpAtomicStore
#                                  (opcode 228) via atomicStore, 4 replay-path
#                                  textureSample-in-switch-default. Remainder:
#                                  546 subgroup ops (naga cannot parse
#                                  `enable subgroups`), 4 int64, 4 binding
#                                  collisions, 2 point-size builtins)
#   zioshade-invalid           0
#   CRASH                      0
#
# ratchet: this file is a point-in-time credibility record. Refresh it (and the
# date) when the corpus or the backend changes; the sweep itself is non-gating
# and always exits 0 unless the HARNESS breaks (missing naga/CLI, empty or
# inconsistent corpus, classifier losing cases, or a configured-but-broken
# TINT).
#
# 2026-08-18 after feat/wgsl-subgroups (on top of #641):
#   roundtrip-valid         1597  (98.8% of the 1611 cases that survived the
#                                  upstream naga+tint leg; 542 of the 546
#                                  subgroup-refused cases now lower)
#   upstream-convert-failed    2  (unchanged)
#   zioshade-refused         14  (10 pre-existing non-subgroup + 4 subgroup
#                                  cross-function refusals, see below)
#   zioshade-invalid           0
#   CRASH                      0
# The validation leg now falls back to tint when naga refuses the output
# (naga cannot even parse `enable subgroups;`; valid if EITHER accepts,
# invalid means BOTH refused). The GroupNonUniform family lowers under
# `enable subgroups;` (MSL's simd_* lowering as the semantic reference):
# vote/ballot/broadcast/shuffle/quad + Reduce and Inclusive/Exclusive scans
# of Add/Mul + subgroup_invocation_id/subgroup_size builtins. Refused
# sharply (no faithful spelling in the dialect): AllEqual, Logical*, the
# ballot-bit ops, Rotate, min/max/bitwise scans, ClusteredReduce, non-
# Subgroup execution scopes, and vertex-stage subgroup use.
# Two supporting fixes fell out:
#   1. single-entry-block-store private-var forwarding: tint's own SPIR-V
#      writer routes every subgroup shuffle delta through a module-scope
#      `tint_subgroup_size_mask` private written at runtime, which tint's
#      uniformity analysis conservatively treats as non-uniform ("requires
#      argument 1 to be uniform"). A private stored exactly once in the
#      owning function's entry block with all accesses in that one function
#      is now forwarded to the stored value (declaration + store suppressed;
#      corpus impact: exactly one file, graphicsfuzz_056, folds
#      `var<private> MATRIX_N` to its stored constant 4; naga+tint valid).
#   2. a NonWritable storage buffer now emits read-mode `var<storage>`:
#      read_write wrongly taints reads as non-uniform (and is the less
#      faithful spelling of a readonly buffer).
# The 4 remaining subgroup refusals are the cross-function shape of the same
# tint idiom (mask stored in the caller, shuffle in a helper): no WGSL
# construct keeps a value uniform across a call graph except a written
# module-scope private, which is exactly what the analysis rejects; the
# honest action is a named refusal.
roundtrip-valid 1597
upstream-convert-failed 2
zioshade-refused 14
zioshade-invalid 0
crash 0
total 1613
